title: 第二十五章 看好了我只表演一次第二十六章 九纹
lines: “我要接受凌族的邀请，我要入凌族。”
林昊豁然起身，语气出奇的坚定，眼中的光芒前所未有的刺眼。
“不行，我不同意。”
任百川急了，他觉得林昊一定是疯了。
“怕什么，我现在是天宝，谁知道我是林昊，凌族没人见过我，既然他们要拉拢我，我就如他们所愿，我不但要答应，而且要深入凌云山，我要吃他们的，喝他们的，用他们的，拿他们的，我要借助他们的资源壮大自身。”
林昊冷冷说道：“我不光吃他们的资源，我还喝他们的血。”
一旁，任百川傻眼了，他忽然觉得这个世界太疯狂了，老鼠要去给猫当伴娘。
这绝对是玩火，玩不好就自焚。
“凌族不是放言决不允许我活着踏入帝都半步吗？我现在来了，我不但踏入了帝都，我还要踏入他们的老巢。”
林昊已经开始兴奋了。
任百川无言以对，只从牙缝里挤出两个字：“疯子。”
他从未见过这么疯狂的人，但不知为何，林昊的话，竟也让他这个老家伙，突然间热血沸腾起来。
“你……决定了？”
任百川神色无比凝重。
“决定了，而且不会改变。”
林昊话语斩钉截铁：“任老，我知道你担忧我安危，但我和凌族的恩怨，希望你能让我自己做决定，有些事情，迟早要去面对。”
“可是，你这是在玩命。”
“修行一途，岂能畏首畏尾，未来要靠自己的命去搏，或许他日我会死于凌族之手，但现在，我想恶心他们。”
林昊浑身上下弥漫着淡淡的王者之威，那是源自于骨子深处的热血在激荡。
任百川叹息一声，只觉得自己老了，失去了年轻时候的血性。
年少轻狂，无所畏惧，方显男儿本性。
任百川不再多说，他觉得自己也在陪林昊疯，对于林昊做出的决定，他突然间，竟期待起来。
一万下品元石被林昊直接笑纳了，这只是一个开始，接下来，他要从凌族手中，索取更多。
自从上次冲击气海境，林昊感受到了至尊体的变化，这种体质过于霸道，每一次晋级所需要的能量，都超出寻常人百倍。
仅仅冲击气海境，他就消耗了两颗下品元石，他能感受到，以后的每一次晋级，消耗都会巨大，从现在开始，元石将成为他修行路上必不可少的基础品，越多越好。
用敌人的资源来强大自己，天底下没有比这更痛快的事情了。
翌日，天一大早，丹阁就热闹起来。
丹阁的中心，有一座庞大的丹道竞技场，此刻已经堆满了人。
这次丹道交流会规模宏大，一百零八宗的炼丹师都来了，可以说是一场炼丹师峰会。
竞技场上人少人海，但秩序却一点都不乱。
“听说今日主持丹道交流会的是景阳大师。”
“是吗？那可是我最崇拜的丹道大师，数年前景阳大师就已经能炼制出半步九纹级别的丹药，听说如今的修为，已经达到了天元境八重，有希望在毕生之年突破神元境。”
content_en:
"I want to accept the invitation from the Ling Clan, and I want to join the Ling Clan."
Lin Hao stood up suddenly, his tone was surprisingly firm, and the light in his eyes was dazzling like never before.
"No, I don't agree."
Ren Baichuan was anxious, he thought Lin Hao must be crazy.
"What are you afraid of? I am Tianbao now. Who knows that I am Lin Hao? No one in the Ling clan has ever seen me. Since they want to win me over, I will do what they want. Not only will I agree, but I will also go deep into Lingyun Mountain. I will eat their food, drink their food, use theirs, and take their money. I will use their resources to strengthen myself."
Lin Hao said coldly: "I not only eat their resources, I also drink their blood."
On the side, Ren Baichuan was dumbfounded. He suddenly felt that the world was too crazy, and the mouse was going to be the cat's bridesmaid.
This is definitely playing with fire. If you don't play well, you will burn yourself.
"Didn't the Ling clan say they would never allow me to step into the imperial capital alive? Now that I'm here, not only do I step into the imperial capital, I also want to step into their lair."
Lin Hao was already excited.
Ren Baichuan was speechless and only squeezed out two words from between his teeth: "Madman."
He had never seen such a crazy person, but for some reason, Lin Hao's words made him, an old guy, suddenly feel excited.
"You...decided?"
Ren Baichuan looked extremely solemn.
"It's decided, and it won't change."
Lin Hao's words were decisive: "Mr. Ren, I know you are worried about my safety, but I hope you will let me make my own decision about my grudges with the Ling clan. There are some things that I have to face sooner or later."
"But you are risking your life."
"How can I be timid during my journey of cultivation? I have to fight for my own life in the future. Maybe I will die at the hands of the Ling clan in the future, but now, I want to disgust them."
Lin Hao's whole body was filled with a touch of kingly power, which was caused by the passion deep in his bones.
Ren Baichuan sighed, feeling that he was getting old and had lost the vitality of his youth.
Being young, frivolous and fearless shows the true nature of a man.
Ren Baichuan said no more. He felt that he was also accompanying Lin Hao crazy. He suddenly started to look forward to Lin Hao's decision.
Lin Hao accepted 10,000 low-grade Yuan stones with a smile. This was just the beginning. Next, he would ask for more from the Ling clan.
Since the last time he hit the Qi Sea Realm, Lin Hao has felt the changes in the Supreme Body. This physique is too domineering, and the energy required for each advancement is a hundred times higher than that of ordinary people.
Just by attacking the Qi Sea Realm, he consumed two low-grade Yuan Stones. He could feel that every time he advanced in the future, the consumption would be huge. From now on, Yuan Stones would become an indispensable basic product on his path of cultivation. The more the better.
There is nothing more satisfying in the world than using the enemy's resources to strengthen yourself.
The next day, early in the morning, Dan Pavilion became lively.
In the center of the Alchemy Pavilion, there is a huge Alchemy Arena, which is already filled with people.
This alchemy exchange meeting was large in scale, with alchemists from one hundred and eight sects present. It could be said to be an alchemist summit.
There were only a few people in the arena, but the order was not chaotic at all.
"I heard that the person hosting the alchemy exchange meeting today is Master Jingyang."
"Really? That's the alchemy master I admire most. Master Xiangyang has been able to refine half-step nine-level elixirs for a few years. I heard that his current cultivation level has reached the eighth level of the Tianyuan realm, and he hopes to break through to the Shenyuan realm in his lifetime."
